item.title: PLD Space secures funding to boost rocket production
item.description: Spanish launch startup PLD Space has raised €180 million ($209 million) in its latest funding round as it prepares for the inaugural flight of its next-generation rocket, Miura 5, AzerNEWS reports, citing foreign media.

item.title: Georgian PM Irakli Kobakhidze made phone call to President Ilham Aliyev
item.description: On March 5, Prime Minister of Georgia Irakli Kobakhidze made a phone call to President of the Republic of Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev.

item.title: Volkswagen’s EV deliveries reach new milestone
item.description: Volkswagen Group (VW) announced on Thursday that its cumulative deliveries of all-electric vehicles (EVs) have reached a historic milestone of 4 million units, just 13 years after the company launched its first electric series in 2013, AzerNEWS reports, citing foreign media.

item.title: China aims to promote reproductive health
item.description: On March 4, the Chinese government announced plans to build a “reproductive health-friendly society” over the next five years, pledging to tackle challenges related to employment, education, healthcare, and income in the process, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: What Iran’s strike on Nakhchivan reveals about its view of region
item.description: Iran’s recent strike on Nakhchivan is a textbook case of barking up the wrong tree. At a time when the United States and Israel are steamrolling over Iran, the regime has chosen to lash out at its neighbors. This choice is neither accidental nor unprecedented; it reflects a deeper pattern in Iran’s foreign policy—a mix of jealousy, insecurity, and aggression toward surrounding states, particularly Muslim-majority countries that it paradoxically claims to defend.

item.title: Sea level rise may put more people at risk
item.description: European geographers have discovered that current forecasts of sea level rise significantly underestimate its impact—by as much as 20–30 centimeters. This discrepancy means that roughly 68 percent more people could be affected than previously thought, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: Azeri Light oil price jumps to nearly $88 per barrel in global markets
item.description: The price of Azeri Light crude delivered on a CIF basis at the port of Augusta Port increased by $5.61, or 6.82 percent, reaching $87.90 per barrel compared with the previous trading session, AzerNEWS reports.

item.title: SOCAR President Rovshan Najaf visits Côte d’Ivoire to discuss energy cooperation
item.description: State Oil Company of the Azerbaijan Republic (SOCAR) President Rovshan Najaf has paid a working visit to Abidjan, the economic capital of Côte d’Ivoire, where he held a series of high-level meetings aimed at strengthening cooperation in the energy sector.

item.title: Azerbaijan discusses critical infrastructure monitoring cooperation with Palantir
item.description: Azerbaijan has discussed potential cooperation with the British-based technology company Palantir Technologies in the field of critical infrastructure monitoring.

item.title: Belgian Embassy condemns Iranian drone strikes on Nakhchivan
item.description: The Belgian Embassy in Azerbaijan has strongly condemned Iran’s drone attacks on the territory of the Nakhchivan Autonomous Republic, expressing solidarity with Baku in the wake of the strikes, AzerNEWS reports.
